# The Examined Classroom

> The Examined Classroom is Matthew A. Zinn's personal education site for classroom-ready thought experiments, AI ethics guidance, practical educator resources, and K-12 AI policy tools.

Canonical domain: https://examinedclassroom.com/
Contact: hello@examinedclassroom.com
Creator: Matthew A. Zinn

## Start Here

- [About Matthew A. Zinn](https://examinedclassroom.com/about): site identity, creator background, and related writing.
- [Interactive Thought Experiments](https://examinedclassroom.com/thought-experiments): K-12 and educator scenarios for philosophy, AI ethics, discussion, and decision-making.
- [Interactive Tools](https://examinedclassroom.com/tools): the Thought Experiment Picker, AI Use Rubric, AI Policy Builder, and Family Conversation Generator.
- [AI in Education](https://examinedclassroom.com/ai-education): teacher- and leader-facing guidance on AI foundations, practice, policy, ethics, and future readiness.
- [AI Ethics in Education](https://examinedclassroom.com/ai-ethics): frameworks and research for responsible school AI decisions.
- [Research Resources](https://examinedclassroom.com/resources): curated books, papers, organizations, podcasts, and references.

## Use and Attribution

- [Terms of Use](https://examinedclassroom.com/terms): educational use, license notes, disclaimers, and limitations.
- [Credits and AI Disclosures](https://examinedclassroom.com/credits): attribution for illustrations, narration, typography, technology, and AI-assisted production.
